text:
, let me ask you something: In the age of AI, who exactly is not a tech-savvy retail investor?

SEBI and the stock exchanges are supposed to protect market participants, simplify processes and make participation easier for retail investors.

But what are you doing instead?

Every other circular seems designed to make the life of an ordinary retail trader more complicated, more cumbersome and more difficult.

Haven\'t you learned anything from the CAS fiasco? A policy that had to be rolled back after massive backlash from market participants.
Over and above, you have to waive your right to file grievance with regulator for losses due to any glitch in Algo even if it happens on broker/exchanges side and not our fault.
IS THE MOST INCOMPETENT ORG. IT IS SIMPLE MAKING LIVES OF RETAIL WORSE BY THEIR LAWS
It has proven it over and over again. We would be better of without them.

Thats whats called market manipulation.
Jinke paiso p sarkar bni hai wo paisa wasool kr rhe hai market se
All in the name of protecting retail Investors and Traders.
These are the same tech savvy retail who take how to use AI workshop in the age of AI…
We all need initial push to learn how to use new things in life, AI is no different.
Sad state of affairs in Indian stock market.
